scanNote: TEKSHIRILDI (skan 78-bet): Ex.8 9 rasm (a past, b towards, c across, d up/down, e along - kitobda 1 deb belgilangan, f under, g into, h through, i over) va matndagi 10 bo'shliq mos; rasm tartibi e-h-b-d-d-a-f-c-i-g. Ex.9 8 so'z (gorgeous/sunny sifat, tightly/loudly ravish, beautiful/scary sifat, desperately/quickly ravish) mos. Ex.10a ro'yxati 7 sifat (quiet, new, old, strange, white, bright, metal) / 7 bo'shliq. Xato topilmadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and the prepositions of movement.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'QQIZ RASM VA TO'QQIZ PREDLOG:

  a  PAST      — kulba YONIDAN o'tib ketish
  b  TOWARDS   — biror narsa TOMON borish
  c  ACROSS    — dala BO'YLAB (bir chetdan ikkinchisiga)
  d  UP / DOWN — tepalikka CHIQISh va TUShISh
  e  ALONG     — yo'l BO'YLAB (uzunasiga)
  f  UNDER     — ko'prik OSTIDAN
  g  INTO      — ko'lga ICHKARIGA (tushib ketish)
  h  THROUGH   — tunnel IChIDAN o'tib
  i  OVER      — panjara USTIDAN sakrab

ENG KO'P ADASHTIRILADIGAN JUFTLIKLAR:

  ALONG ↔ ACROSS
     ALONG  — UZUNASIGA (yo'l bo'ylab yurish)
     ACROSS — KO'NDALANG (bir chetdan ikkinchisiga)

  THROUGH ↔ ACROSS
     THROUGH — biror narsaning IChIDAN
               (tunnel, o'rmon, tepa yopiq)
     ACROSS  — biror narsaning USTIDAN, yuzasi bo'ylab
               (dala, ko'cha, tepa ochiq)

  OVER ↔ UNDER
     OVER  — USTIDAN (tegmasdan)
     UNDER — OSTIDAN

  INTO ↔ OUT OF
     INTO   — ICHKARIGA
     OUT OF — TAShQARIGA

  TO ↔ TOWARDS
     TO      — yetib borish (maqsad)
     TOWARDS — ...TOMON (yo'nalish, yetib borish shart emas)

DIQQAT — 'PAST' IKKI XIL SO'Z:
  'past' PREDLOG = yonidan o'tib
     He walked PAST the shop.
  'the past' OT = o'tmish
     'the past simple' = oddiy o'tgan zamon

points.noteUz:
a-rasm: chavandoz kulba yonidan o'tyapti.
'walk PAST the shop' = do'kon yonidan o'tmoq.
DIQQAT: 'past' oti = o'tmish.

b-rasm: chavandoz biror narsa tomon boryapti.
YO'NALISh bildiradi, yetib borish shart emas.
77-betdagi hikoyada: 'ran TOWARDS the jeep'.

c-rasm: chavandoz dala bo'ylab o'tyapti.
OChIQ maydon yuzasi bo'ylab.
'across the road' = ko'chaning narigi tomoniga.

d-rasm: tepalikka chiqish va tushish.
'go UP the hill' = tepalikka chiqmoq.
'go DOWN the hill' = tepalikdan tushmoq.

e-rasm: chavandoz yo'l bo'ylab boryapti.
UZUN narsa (yo'l, daryo, sohil) bo'ylab.
'across' bilan farqi: 'along' uzunasiga, 'across' ko'ndalang.

f-rasm: chavandoz ko'prik ostidan o'tyapti.
Aksi: over.

g-rasm: ot ko'lga tushib ketyapti, chavandoz yiqilyapti.
Aksi: out of.

h-rasm: chavandoz tunnel ichidan o'tyapti.
YOPIQ yoki qalin narsa ichidan
(tunnel, o'rmon, olomon).

i-rasm: ot panjara ustidan sakrayapti.
'jump OVER a fence' = panjara ustidan sakramoq.
Aksi: under.

exercises.instructionEn: Ralph went horse-riding in the countryside. First, look at the pictures and use the prepositions to fill in the gaps in the text.
exercises.instructionUz: Ralf qishloqda ot mingani bordi. Avval rasmlarga qarang va predloglar bilan matndagi bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  It was a lovely day, so Ralph decided to go for a ride in
  the countryside. He got on his horse and rode out of the
  field. At first, everything was fine. He went ALONG the
  road, THROUGH the tunnel and TOWARDS the forest. Then, he
  went UP the hill. The view from there was beautiful!
  After that, he went DOWN the other side of the hill, PAST
  a little old cottage and UNDER the bridge. After that, he
  went ACROSS a field. Suddenly, everything went wrong! A
  tractor scared the horse and it jumped OVER the fence.
  Ralph fell off the horse and INTO the lake. He got very
  wet! It was a horrible experience!


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Kun ajoyib edi, shuning uchun Ralf qishloqqa ot mingani
  borishga qaror qildi. U otiga mindi va daladan chiqib
  ketdi. Dastlab hammasi yaxshi edi. U yo'l bo'ylab,
  tunnel ichidan o'tib, o'rmon tomon bordi. So'ng tepalikka
  chiqdi. U yerdan manzara go'zal edi! Shundan keyin
  tepalikning narigi tomonidan tushdi, kichkina eski kulba
  yonidan o'tdi va ko'prik ostidan o'tdi. Shundan keyin
  dala bo'ylab bordi. To'satdan hammasi noto'g'ri ketdi!
  Traktor otni qo'rqitdi va u panjara ustidan sakradi.
  Ralf otdan yiqilib ko'lga tushdi. U juda ho'l bo'ldi!
  Bu dahshatli tajriba edi!


RASMLAR TARTIBI (matnga qarab):
  1  e  — along the road
  2  h  — through the tunnel
  3  b  — towards the forest
  4  d  — up the hill
  5  d  — down the other side  (SHU RASM, ikkinchi qismi)
  6  a  — past a little old cottage
  7  f  — under the bridge
  8  c  — across a field
  9  i  — over the fence
  10 g  — into the lake

DIQQAT: 'd' rasmi IKKITA raqam oladi (4 va 5) —
chunki unda ham chiqish, ham tushish ko'rsatilgan.
Shuning uchun kitobda 'd' qutisida qiya chiziq bor.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  the countryside = qishloq joy
  to go for a ride = sayr qilgani (ot yoki velosipedda) bormoq
  to get on a horse = otga minmoq
  a field         = dala
  at first        = dastlab
  a tunnel        = tunnel
  a forest        = o'rmon
  a hill          = tepalik
  a view          = manzara
  a cottage       = kulba
  a bridge        = ko'prik
  a tractor       = traktor
  to scare        = qo'rqitmoq
  a fence         = panjara, devor
  to fall off     = yiqilmoq (ustidan)
  a lake          = ko'l
  wet             = ho'l
  horrible        = dahshatli
  an experience   = tajriba

items.whyUz:
'ALONG the road' = yo'l bo'ylab (uzunasiga).
Rasm e — kitobda '1' deb raqamlangan.

'THROUGH the tunnel' = tunnel ichidan o'tib.
Tunnel — yopiq joy → THROUGH.
Rasm h.

'TOWARDS the forest' = o'rmon tomon.
DIQQAT: 'through the forest' bo'lsa o'rmon IChIDAN
o'tgan bo'lardi, lekin matnda o'rmonga YETIB BORMAGAN —
faqat o'sha tomonga ketgan.
Rasm b.

items.textEn: 4  Then, he went ............ the hill.  (rasm d)
items.whyUz:
'UP the hill' = tepalikka chiqmoq.
Keyingi gapda 'The view from THERE was beautiful' —
demak tepaga chiqqan.
Rasm d (birinchi qismi).

items.textEn: 5  After that, he went ............ the other side of the hill,  (rasm d)
items.whyUz:
'DOWN the other side' = narigi tomonidan tushmoq.
4-band bilan JUFT: chiqdi (up) → tushdi (down).
Rasm d (ikkinchi qismi) — shuning uchun 'd' qutisida
qiya chiziq bor.

'PAST a cottage' = kulba yonidan o'tib.
To'xtamadi, faqat yonidan o'tdi.
Rasm a.
DIQQAT: 'a little old cottage' — sifatlar tartibi:
o'lcham (little) → yosh (old).

'UNDER the bridge' = ko'prik ostidan.
Rasm f.
DIQQAT: 'over the bridge' bo'lsa ko'prik USTIDAN
o'tgan bo'lardi — rasmda esa ostidan o'tyapti.

items.textEn: 8  After that, he went ............ a field.  (rasm c)
items.whyUz:
'ACROSS a field' = dala bo'ylab (bir chetdan ikkinchisiga).
Dala — ochiq maydon → ACROSS.
Rasm c — u yerda TRAKTOR ham ko'rinadi,
bu keyingi gapga bog'liq.

items.textEn: 9  A tractor scared the horse and it jumped ............ the fence.  (rasm i)
items.whyUz:
'jump OVER the fence' = panjara ustidan sakramoq.
Rasm i.
'to scare' = qo'rqitmoq;  'a fence' = panjara.

items.textEn: 10  Ralph fell off the horse and ............ the lake.  (rasm g)
items.whyUz:
'INTO the lake' = ko'lga (ichkariga) tushmoq.
Rasm g.
'fall off' = ustidan yiqilmoq;  fall → FELL (noto'g'ri fe'l).
DIQQAT: 'fell off the horse AND into the lake' —
ikki harakat: otdan yiqildi VA ko'lga tushdi.

exercises.instructionEn: Then, put the pictures in the correct order. Finally, look at the pictures and tell the story.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng rasmlarni to'g'ri tartibga qo'ying. Nihoyat, rasmlarga qarab hikoyani so'zlab bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMLAR TARTIBI matnga qarab aniqlanadi.

Kitob 'e' rasmini '1' deb raqamlagan.

TO'LIQ TARTIB:
  1 → e (along the road)
  2 → h (through the tunnel)
  3 → b (towards the forest)
  4 → d (up the hill)
  5 → d (down the other side)
  6 → a (past the cottage)
  7 → f (under the bridge)
  8 → c (across a field)
  9 → i (over the fence)
  10 → g (into the lake)

DIQQAT: 'd' rasmi IKKI marta (4 va 5) —
kitobda uning qutisida qiya chiziq bor.

HIKOYANI SO'ZLASHDA ketma-ketlik so'zlaridan foydalaning
(77-betdagi qoida):
  First, ... Then, ... After that, ... Suddenly, ...
  Finally, ...

items.whyUz: Rasm 'e' qutisida '1' yozilgan.
Matnda: 'along the road, THROUGH THE TUNNEL and ...'
Matnda: '... and TOWARDS THE FOREST.'
Matnda: 'Then, he went UP THE HILL.'

items.answer: d — down the other side of the hill  (SHU rasm, ikkinchi qismi)
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'he went DOWN THE OTHER SIDE of the hill'.
'd' rasmida ham chiqish, ham tushish ko'rsatilgan —
shuning uchun u IKKI raqam oladi.

items.answer: a — past a little old cottage
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'PAST A LITTLE OLD COTTAGE'.
Matnda: 'and UNDER THE BRIDGE'.

Matnda: 'he went ACROSS A FIELD'.
Rasmda TRAKTOR ham bor — keyingi voqeaga bog'liq.
Matnda: 'it jumped OVER THE FENCE'.

Matnda: 'Ralph fell off the horse and INTO THE LAKE'.
Hikoyaning oxirgi voqeasi.

exercises.instructionEn: Adjectives describe nouns. Adverbs usually describe verbs.
exercises.instructionUz: Sifat otni aniqlaydi. Ravish odatda fe'lni aniqlaydi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

  SIFAT (adjective) — OTNI aniqlaydi.
     He is a CAREFUL DRIVER.
     (What kind of driver is he? CAREFUL.)
     = U qanday haydovchi? Ehtiyotkor.

  RAVISH (adverb) — odatda FE'LNI aniqlaydi.
     He drives CAREFULLY.
     (How does he drive? CAREFULLY.)
     = U qanday haydaydi? Ehtiyotkorlik bilan.

QANDAY ANIQLASH — SAVOL BERING:

  'WHAT KIND OF ...?' (qanday?) → SIFAT
     a careful driver, a beautiful day, scary animals

  'HOW ...?' (qanday qilib?) → RAVISH
     drives carefully, roared loudly, screamed desperately

GAPDA JOYI:

  SIFAT:
     otdan OLDIN:        a CAREFUL driver
     'to be' dan KEYIN:  He is CAREFUL.

  RAVISH:
     fe'ldan KEYIN:      He drives CAREFULLY.
                         The lions roared LOUDLY.

RAVISH YASALIShI — SIFAT + LY:
  careful → carefully
  loud    → loudly
  quick   → quickly
  tight   → tightly
  desperate → desperately

ISTISNOLAR:
  good → WELL   ('goodly' YO'Q!)
  fast → FAST   (o'zgarmaydi)
  hard → HARD   (o'zgarmaydi)
  early → EARLY (o'zgarmaydi)

DIQQAT — -LY BILAN TUGAGAN SIFATLAR HAM BOR:
  friendly, lovely, lonely, silly — bular SIFAT!
  'He smiled friendly' XATO →
  'He smiled in a friendly way' ✓


IKKINCHI QUTI — SIFATLAR HIKOYANI QIZIQARLI QILADI:

  Sifatlar hikoyalarimizni qiziqarliroq qiladi.
  'One day last summer, they went to the park ...'
  o'rniga
  'One BEAUTIFUL SUNNY day last summer, they went to the
  park ...' deb yozishimiz mumkin.

  77-betdagi hikoya ham shunday boshlangan:
  'One GORGEOUS, SUNNY day last summer ...'

points.en: He is a careful driver. (What kind of driver is he? Careful.)
points.uz: U ehtiyotkor haydovchi. (U qanday haydovchi? Ehtiyotkor.)
points.noteUz:
SIFAT otdan OLDIN turadi.
'What kind of ...?' savoliga javob beradi.

KITOBDAGI 2-QOIDA.
'usually' — chunki ravish sifatni ham aniqlashi mumkin
('VERY beautiful').

points.en: He drives carefully. (How does he drive? Carefully.)
points.uz: U ehtiyotkorlik bilan haydaydi. (U qanday haydaydi? Ehtiyotkorlik bilan.)
points.noteUz:
RAVISH fe'ldan KEYIN turadi.
'How ...?' savoliga javob beradi.

SIFAT + LY = RAVISH.
Bu — asosiy yasash usuli.

ISTISNO: 'good' ning ravishi 'WELL'.
'goodly' shakli YO'Q.
'He speaks English WELL.' ✓

ISTISNO: bu so'zlar sifat ham, ravish ham.
'a FAST car' (sifat) / 'He drives FAST' (ravish).
'fastly' shakli YO'Q.

points.en: friendly, lovely, silly — these are ADJECTIVES
points.noteUz:
-ly bilan tugaydi, lekin RAVISH EMAS!
'He smiled friendly' XATO.
'He smiled in a friendly way' ✓

points.en: Adjectives make our stories more interesting.
Instead of 'One day last summer' we can write 'One beautiful sunny day last summer'.
points.uz: 'O'tgan yozning bir kunida' o'rniga 'O'tgan yozning go'zal, quyoshli kunida' deb yozishimiz mumkin.
points.noteUz:
77-betdagi hikoya shunday boshlangan:
'One GORGEOUS, SUNNY day last summer ...'
Ikki sifat vergul bilan ajratilgan.

exercises.instructionEn: The following adjectives and adverbs are from the story in Ex. 4. Underline them in the text and decide which are adjectives and which are adverbs. Which word does each describe?
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi sifat va ravishlar 4-mashqdagi hikoyadan olingan. Ularni matnda tagiga chizing va qaysi biri sifat, qaysi biri ravish ekanini aniqlang. Har biri qaysi so'zni aniqlaydi?
exercises.explanationUz:
USUL:
  1) So'zni 77-betdagi matndan toping
  2) U OTNI aniqlayaptimi yoki FE'LNI?
       ot → SIFAT;  fe'l → RAVISH
  3) Qaysi so'zni aniqlashini yozing

OSON BELGI:
  -LY bilan tugagan bo'lsa — odatda RAVISH
     tightly, loudly, desperately, quickly
  -LY siz bo'lsa — odatda SIFAT
     gorgeous, sunny, beautiful, scary

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  gorgeous  →  adjective: day

items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'One GORGEOUS, sunny DAY last summer'.
'gorgeous' — 'day' otini aniqlaydi → SIFAT.

Matnda: 'One gorgeous, SUNNY DAY last summer'.
'sunny' ham 'day' otini aniqlaydi → SIFAT.
Ikki sifat bir otni aniqlaydi, vergul bilan ajratilgan.
'sun' + -y → sifat.

Matnda: 'they CLOSED the car windows TIGHTLY'.
'tightly' — 'closed' fe'lini aniqlaydi → RAVISH.
Savol: qanday yopishdi? Mahkam.
'tight' + -ly → ravish.

Matnda: 'The lions ROARED LOUDLY'.
'loudly' — 'roared' fe'lini aniqlaydi → RAVISH.
Savol: qanday bo'kirishdi? Baland ovozda.
'loud' + -ly → ravish.

Matnda: "They're BEAUTIFUL, but very scary ANIMALS".
'beautiful' — 'animals' otini aniqlaydi → SIFAT.
DIQQAT: 'They're beautiful' — 'to be' dan keyin turgan
sifat ham otga tegishli ('they' = animals).

Matnda: 'beautiful, but very SCARY ANIMALS'.
'scary' — 'animals' otini aniqlaydi → SIFAT.
'scare' (qo'rqitmoq) + -y → sifat.
DIQQAT: 'scary' (narsa) ↔ 'scared' (odam).

Matnda: 'Claire SCREAMED DESPERATELY'.
'desperately' — 'screamed' fe'lini aniqlaydi → RAVISH.
Savol: qanday qichqirdi? Jon holatda.
'desperate' + -ly → ravish.

Matnda: 'Claire and Greg JUMPED OUT of the car QUICKLY'.
'quickly' — 'jumped out' fe'lini aniqlaydi → RAVISH.
Savol: qanday sakrab chiqishdi? Tez.
'quick' + -ly → ravish.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the adjectives from the lists.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (7 ta sifat, 7 ta bo'shliq):
  quiet, new, old, strange, white, bright, metal

Har biri AYNAN BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.

TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Suzy got into her NEW car and started to drive home along
  a QUIET country road. Suddenly, she saw a BRIGHT light in
  the sky above her. She felt really frightened. Then, she
  heard STRANGE voices. She saw an OLD man with WHITE hair
  and blue eyes. He had a METAL object in his hand and he
  pointed it at the car.


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Syuzi yangi mashinasiga o'tirdi va tinch qishloq yo'li
  bo'ylab uyga haydab keta boshladi. To'satdan u tepasidagi
  osmonda yorqin nurni ko'rdi. U juda qo'rqib ketdi. So'ng
  g'alati ovozlarni eshitdi. U oq sochli va ko'k ko'zli
  keksa odamni ko'rdi. Uning qo'lida metall buyum bor edi
  va u uni mashinaga qaratdi.

USUL — MANTIQQA QARANG:
  ... car        → qanday mashina? → new
  ... country road → qanday yo'l? → quiet
  ... light      → qanday nur?  → bright
  ... voices     → qanday ovozlar? → strange
  AN ... man     → 'AN' bor → UNLI tovushdan boshlanadi → old
  ... hair       → qanday soch? → white
  ... object     → nimadan yasalgan? → metal

ENG MUHIM MASLAHAT — ARTIKLGA QARANG:
  'AN 5) ...... man' — 'AN' bor, demak keyingi so'z
  UNLI tovush bilan boshlanishi kerak → OLD.
  ('a new man', 'a strange man' bo'lsa 'A' bo'lardi.)

DIQQAT — 'METAL' SIFAT SIFATIDA:
  'a METAL object' = metall buyum.
  Bu yerda 'metal' — OT, lekin boshqa otni aniqlab,
  SIFAT vazifasini bajaryapti.
Shunga o'xshash: a stone cottage, a glass door.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a country road = qishloq yo'li
  bright         = yorqin
  frightened     = qo'rqib ketgan
  strange        = g'alati
  a voice        = ovoz
  an object      = buyum, narsa
  to point at    = ...ga qaratmoq, ko'rsatmoq

items.whyUz:
'her NEW car' = uning yangi mashinasi.
'get INTO a car' = mashinaga o'tirmoq —
8-mashqdagi 'into' predlogi.

items.textEn: 2  ... and started to drive home along a ............ country road.
items.whyUz:
'a QUIET country road' = tinch qishloq yo'li.
'quiet' = tinch, jimjit.
'ALONG a road' — 8-mashqdagi predlog.

items.textEn: 3  Suddenly, she saw a ............ light in the sky above her.
items.whyUz:
'a BRIGHT light' = yorqin nur.
'bright' = yorqin, porloq.
'above her' = uning tepasida.

'STRANGE voices' = g'alati ovozlar.
'strange' = g'alati, notanish.
DIQQAT: 'voices' KO'PLIK → artikl KERAK EMAS.

'AN OLD man' = keksa odam.
ENG MUHIM BELGI: 'AN' artikli berilgan →
keyingi so'z UNLI tovush bilan boshlanishi kerak.
Ro'yxatda faqat 'OLD' unli bilan boshlanadi.
('a new man', 'a strange man' bo'lsa 'A' bo'lardi.)

'WHITE hair' = oq soch.
Keksa odam — oq sochli.
DIQQAT: 'hair' SANALMAYDIGAN → artikl YO'Q.
'blue eyes' bilan juft — ikkalasi ham rang.

items.textEn: 7  He had a ............ object in his hand ...
items.whyUz:
'a METAL object' = metall buyum.
DIQQAT: 'metal' — OT, lekin bu yerda boshqa otni
aniqlab SIFAT vazifasini bajaryapti.
Shunga o'xshash: a stone cottage, a glass door,
a paper bag.
'to point AT' = ...ga qaratmoq.

wordFormation.introUz: 78-bet — harakat predloglari, sifat va ravish yasalishi.

groups.ruleUz: ALONG, ACROSS, THROUGH — eng ko'p adashtiriladigan uchlik

groups.explanationUz: Ot boshqa otni aniqlashi mumkin — material yoki turi.

patterns.formula: He went ALONG / THROUGH / ACROSS / PAST / UNDER / OVER + joy.
patterns.exampleEn: He went along the road, through the tunnel and towards the forest.
patterns.exampleUz: U yo'l bo'ylab, tunnel ichidan o'tib, o'rmon tomon bordi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Harakat predloglari yo'nalishni aniq ko'rsatadi.
Bir gapda bir nechtasi 'and' bilan bog'lanishi mumkin.

patterns.formula: He went UP the hill ... and DOWN the other side.
patterns.exampleEn: Then, he went up the hill. After that, he went down the other side of the hill.
patterns.exampleUz: So'ng tepalikka chiqdi. Shundan keyin tepalikning narigi tomonidan tushdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'up' va 'down' — aks juftlik.
'the other side' = narigi tomon.

patterns.formula: Ega + JUMPED OVER + narsa.   /   Ega + FELL OFF + narsa AND INTO + joy.
patterns.exampleEn: It jumped over the fence. Ralph fell off the horse and into the lake.
patterns.exampleUz: U panjara ustidan sakradi. Ralf otdan yiqilib ko'lga tushdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'jump OVER' = ustidan sakramoq.
'fall OFF' = ustidan yiqilmoq;  'fall INTO' = ichiga tushmoq.

patterns.formula: Ega + IS + A/AN + SIFAT + OT.   ↔   Ega + FE'L + RAVISH.
patterns.exampleEn: He is a careful driver. He drives carefully.
patterns.exampleUz: U ehtiyotkor haydovchi. U ehtiyotkorlik bilan haydaydi.
patterns.explanationUz:
SIFAT otni aniqlaydi (What kind of ...?).
RAVISH fe'lni aniqlaydi (How ...?).

patterns.formula: ONE + sifat + sifat + DAY + vaqt, + ega + fe'l ... .
patterns.exampleEn: One beautiful sunny day last summer, they went to the park.
patterns.exampleUz: O'tgan yozning go'zal, quyoshli kunida ular bog'ga borishdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Sifatlar hikoyani QIZIQARLIROQ qiladi.
Ikki sifat vergul bilan ajratiladi.

patterns.formula: She saw AN OLD man WITH + tashqi belgi.
patterns.exampleEn: She saw an old man with white hair and blue eyes.
patterns.exampleUz: U oq sochli va ko'k ko'zli keksa odamni ko'rdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'with' — tashqi ko'rinishni tasvirlash uchun.
'AN old' — 'o' unli tovush → AN.
